method: translational penetration depth (26 directions, ladder 1.5-100 mm, bisection-refined), python-fcl BVH meshes of the recorded triangles, containment by winding numbers; a pair is re-checked when a mesh or the relative pose changes; a pair deeper than its limit is re-checked every frame at the limit, its depth re-measured at most every 6 frames
memory: streamed: BVHs dropped every 200 recorded frames and past 1800 MB
cad_overlap_note: two parts drawn at their designed relative pose (one machine frame) and overlapping there: the CAD's own overlap (a groove or hole the model does not cut), listed apart and not counted
